name: query-type-narrowing-test-74c51d5294/query-type-narrowing-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Supports `from`, `where`, `let`, `join` (including outer join), `order by`, `limit`, `on conflict` and `select` clauses
## Statements: the supported statement list does not include query actions
reason: The case asserts rejection of arguments and singleton assignments after query filtering. Several assertions occur inside from/where/do query actions, including the literal-narrowing assertions. Query actions and their do clause are not covered by the supported statement list or the enumerated query-expression clauses, so an essential part of this whole case is outside the documented subset.
unsupported_constructs: Query actions with a terminal do block
test_design_notes: Negative type errors alone do not make a case unsupported; the deciding omission is query-action syntax used by the assertions.
